packageRules.description: Small, safe updates (patch + minor) grouped into one weekly PR
Major upgrades (e.g. Spring Boot 5) always get their own PR and need a careful look
Spring Boot, Spring Cloud and the shop-parent security overrides move together: one PR, never split by update type (a split pair fails Spring Cloud's startup compatibility check)

A minor/major Spring Boot or Spring Cloud jump only works with a compatible partner release (Boot X needs Cloud train Y). Renovate cannot require both to exist, so these wait for a human click on the Dependency Dashboard after checking the Spring Cloud compatibility table. Patch updates flow automatically.

Overrides should stay on the line Spring Boot was tested with: a minor/major jump waits for a click on the Dependency Dashboard instead of opening a PR (security fixes still open immediately: vulnerabilityAlerts skips this approval)
Our own artifacts: app images are deployed by commit tag via GitOps, and com.example:shop-parent lives in this repo, not in Maven Central
